title: 연구학교에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Institutions <Ordinance No. 1, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. [Proviso omitted.]
Articles 2 through 6
Omitted.
Article 7 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (35) Omitted.
(36) Part of the Rules on Research Schools shall be amended as follows:
In the former sentence of Article 4 (6), the proviso to Article 5 (1), paragraph (2) of the same Article, the proviso to Article 7, and Article 9, "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall in each case be replaced with "Minister of Education".
(37) through (61) Omitted.
